success.description: M You assume the form of a crow. Place the ° Crow Beastform card on your character sheet —you can only use the physical characteristics and skills shown on the card, and can fly. While in beastform, you can only use spells with the Beastform trait. You resume human form when you are knocked unconscious or killed, or when the act ends or you voluntarily end the spell as a manoeuvre. In any case, this card will not recharge until the end of the act

boon.description: You may perform a free manoeuvre as you change form &

bane.description: —1 to all mental checks except Observation and Intuition while in beastform &

chaosStar.description: {Dm} Your animal instincts take over. You add {Dm} to all actions while in beastform.

reckless.requirements: 7 power, must perform the prepare manoeuvre
reckless.name: Form of the Crow
